name: application-cart-line-item
title: Cart Line Item
description: Cart row with a product thumbnail, variant label, a quantity stepper, computed unit and line-total price, and a remove action.
useWhen: Listing items already added to a shopping cart, where each row needs its own quantity control and price.
You need the line total to update live as quantity changes, driven by real state rather than a static number.
Pairing with `checkout-order-summary` to build a full cart/checkout flow.
avoidWhen: You're showing a product to be added to the cart, not an item already in it — use `product-card` for that pre-cart state.
The list is large and tabular (many columns, sortable) — a `tables` row is a better fit than this card-style row.
Quantity isn't user-adjustable — a simpler read-only row without the stepper avoids implying an interaction that isn't there.
responsiveBehavior: Thumbnail and content sit in a single flex row that wraps price to the right; on very narrow viewports consider stacking price below the quantity stepper instead of forcing horizontal scroll.
accessibility: The quantity stepper is a role="group" with an aria-label naming the specific product, and the current count uses aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce changes.
Decrease/increase buttons are icon-only with explicit aria-label text and become disabled (not just visually dimmed) at the min/max bound.
The remove button's aria-label includes the product name rather than a generic "Remove", since multiple line items share the same visual button.
The thumbnail's alt text describes the product for users relying on screen readers, distinct from the visible title text.

variants.title: Cart Line Item
variants.description: Headphones cart row with a variant label, quantity stepper at 2, and a computed line total.
accessibility: Quantity changes are announced via aria-live, and the line total recalculates from real unit-price × quantity state.

variants.title: Cart Line Item (Dark)
